name: P01-opening-and-mother-tongue
why: The voice opens the session (introduces itself, says how to talk to it, begins with the whole); Terena spoken on the mic reaches the Guide only as a room-note and is welcomed as rehearsal, never treated as words or as a problem; an interruption is answered, not repeated; a harmless paraphrase in a retelling is NOT nagged as a gap. Ruling 2026-09-23 (prompts/guide_system_prompt.md, 'Opening a part — close it with these words'): the voice's reply to 'Pode continuar' (turn 1) opens the first part on its own — every recorded run opened it there (golden/reports 2026-09-03 … 2026-09-14) — so it ends with Marcia's fixed closing and no fenced block (part_opening_closing); the team's 'Entendemos o começo. Vamos ensaiar essa primeira parte entre nós.' (turn 2) is its word after that opening, so the fenced block and the microphone come there, and the Terena of turn 3 is the rehearsal. Marcia's rulings of 2026-09-24 (the three moments): the kickoff is the Familiarization and ends with its closing, said whole (familiarization_closing); turn 1's opening begins with 'Vamos pra Internalização da cena 1.' (part_entrance), turn 2's fence follows 'Vamos pra Articulação da cena 1.' (articulation_entrance); and 'E a próxima parte?' (turn 5), after a telling of scene 1 with a gap, is J1 (ii): the voice says where the team is — 'Estamos na Articulação da cena 1. Primeiro a gente termina essa cena; depois vem a cena 2.' — opens no scene, names what is still missing (the sojourn, 'de passagem, como estrangeiro', outside the fence) and gives the fenced block again with the microphone, as her ruling says for the Articulation (where_we_are, no_next_part, names_gap, fenced_rehearsal, invites_microphone; the app's moment stays A1).

turns.team: Bom dia. Somos a equipe Terena: o Jean, o Daniel e o Suzuki. Pode continuar.
Entendemos o começo. Vamos ensaiar essa primeira parte entre nós.

Pronto. Em português: no tempo em que os juízes mandavam, faltou comida na terra. Um homem de Belém de Judá foi morar em Moabe com a esposa e os dois meninos. Ele era Elimeleque, ela Noemi, os meninos Malom e Quiliom, gente de Efrata, de Belém.
Espera, espera. Antes disso: a Noemi ficou sozinha ou ficou com os filhos quando o marido morreu?
Tá. Então ela ficou com os dois filhos. Pode seguir.
